claims.text:
10. matrix-factorisation-tastes

Target / packet: ai-matrix-factorisation-tastes · R1. Prerequisites: ai:collaborative-filtering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: collaborative-filtering → ai-collaborative-filtering. Neighbour co-interaction scoring differs from multiplying low-rank user/item factors, whose coordinates admit nonunique rescaling.

Finite primary model: User factors U 1=[1,0], U 2=[0,1], U 3=[1,1]; item factors A=[2,0], B=[0,3], C=[1,1]. Dot products produce rows [2,0,1],[0,3,1],[2,3,2].

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Transform users U'=2 U and items V'=V/2: identical predictions with different coordinates. Latent axes are not uniquely identified human tastes; no training optimization is implied.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict U 3 score C=2; recall why scaled factors cannot justify naming a coordinate as a psychological trait.

Required observable evidence: Expose factors and computed matrix cell; no blackbox score lookup.
